narration:1:1064301001:0.text: A mechanical messenger bearing an invitation whirs steadily as it sweeps overhead.
narration:1:1064301001:0.source_cn: 一个携带邀请函的机械信使划过低空，发出规律的嗡鸣

narration:2:1064301002:0.text: Across the barren mountain range below, ancient runes flicker faintly amid the desolation.
narration:2:1064301002:0.source_cn: 在它下方，是一片荒芜的山地，隐约间，可见古老的符文闪烁

narration:3:1064301003:0.text: Then, a gauntleted arm emerges from nowhere, seizing the messenger in an iron grip...
narration:3:1064301003:0.source_cn: 一只覆盖暗色金属甲胄的大手猛然从阴影中伸出，将机械信使...

say:7:1064301005:0.text: Gunnar removes the invitation from the messenger. Just as he is about to toss it aside, the word "weapon" makes him stop short.
say:7:1064301005:0.source_cn: 勒图姆摘下机械信使携带的邀请函，在丢弃之前，目光无意间...

say:9:1064301006:0.text: He unfolds the letter. Across the top, a bold heading reads: <style="highlight">Brimstone Village Weapon-Making Open Contest</style>.
say:9:1064301006:0.source_cn: 他展开邀请函，其正上方写着：<style=highli...

say:10:1064301007:0.text:
Note:
Contestants of all backgrounds are welcome. Only your skill will be judged.
say:10:1064301007:0.source_cn: 无限制一行注：\n不论参赛者出身如何，来自何方，武器锻...

say:11:1064301008:0.text:
Weapon-making. Contest.
A chance. To test my weapons.
say:11:1064301008:0.source_cn: 武器锻造，竞赛。\n火力，验证。

narration:14:1064301076:0.text: Brimstone Village square, buzzing with voices...

say:16:1064301009:0.text: Welcome to Brimstone Village, where the forges run around the clock! I'm your old friend, Gonrad!
say:16:1064301009:0.source_cn: 各位！欢迎来到深岩村，锻造炉火永不熄灭之地！我是你们的...

say:17:1064301010:0.text: The dwarves are honored to present Esperia's most inclusive <style="highlight">weapon-making contest</style>! Registration closes soon!
say:17:1064301010:0.source_cn: 由矮人一族举办，伊索米亚有史以来最开放、最自由的<st...

say:18:1064301011:0.text: Are you ready for this legendary contest? Let's make some noise!
say:18:1064301011:0.source_cn: 让我们用热情，点燃这传奇的序幕！

say:21:1064301012:0.text: Hey, big fellow, that old rifle of yours still looks as good as new!
say:21:1064301012:0.source_cn: 嘿，大个子，你带来的膛线可是个老设计了，不过保养得真不错。

say:22:1064301013:0.text: Madam, I can smell gunpowder on you from here. Be careful, alright?
say:22:1064301013:0.source_cn: 还有这位女士，我闻到你身上的火药味了，可要注意安全啊！

say:23:1064301014:0.text: Looks like we've got some tough competition this year. The dwarves had better bring our best!
say:23:1064301014:0.source_cn: 今年的选手藏龙卧虎，看来，冠军之争会很激烈，我们矮人一...

say:25:1064301015:0.text:
This is so... BORING!
Zanie, you promised this would be exciting! Watching a bunch of country bumpkins shove each other around is hardly my idea of fun!
say:25:1064301015:0.source_cn: 好——无——聊——啊！\n祖娅， 不是说会有热闹看嘛！...

say:26:1064301016:0.text: Patience. See that? Kornuk's been looking daggers at that bearfolk craftsman for quite a while now.
say:26:1064301016:0.source_cn: 别心急嘛，小丫头。喏，看那边，寇恩已经瞪了那个熊人工匠...

say:27:1064301017:0.text: I say they'll be at each other's throats in ten minutes. Want to bet on it?
say:27:1064301017:0.source_cn: 要不要打个赌，不出十分钟，他们就会吵起来。

say:28:1064301018:0.text:
I love drama! Where is it?!
Fight! Fight! Fight! Boomboom, who do you think will win?
say:28:1064301018:0.source_cn: 打架，哪，在哪在哪？！\n打起来！打起来！阿爆，你说谁会赢？

say:30:1064301019:0.text: Oh-ho! Both of them would cower in the almighty Lady Kulu's presence!
say:30:1064301019:0.source_cn: 哦哦哦，在无敌的、至尊的库露露大人面前，所有人都会望风而降！

say:31:1064301020:0.text: That's a fair point... Wait, hey! Boomboom, are you even listening to what I'm saying?!
say:31:1064301020:0.source_cn: 说得倒也不错……不对，啊喂，阿爆，你到底有没有在认真听...

say:35:1064301021:0.text: Zanie, we've got a problem! A strange guy showed up for the contest, but his name doesn't match the one on the invitation!
say:35:1064301021:0.source_cn: 祖娅！不好了！有个奇怪的家伙来参赛，但他和邀请函上的名...

say:36:1064301022:0.text: We tried reasoning with him, but he ignored us completely and kept pushing his way in!
say:36:1064301022:0.source_cn: 我们怎么劝他都不听，也不说话，非要往里进！

say:38:1064301023:0.text: Hmph. He's got some nerve causing trouble in Brimstone Village. Come on, take me to him.
say:38:1064301023:0.source_cn: 嘿，是哪个不长眼的家伙敢在深岩村的地盘上闹事，走，带我...

say:39:1064301024:0.text: From the lingering traces of the <style="highlight">abyss</style> on the invitation, Kulu realizes that a <style="highlight">Hypogean</style> must have come into contact with it.
say:39:1064301024:0.source_cn: 这时，库露露敏锐察觉到邀请函上散发着来自<style=...

say:42:1064301025:0.text: Hold on! Let me handle this! A small fry like him isn't worth your time, Zanie!
say:42:1064301025:0.source_cn: 等等等等！我去，让我去！这种小角色，哪用得着祖娅你出手...

say:43:1064301026:0.text: Well, well, miracles do happen! Since when did you become so helpful?
say:43:1064301026:0.source_cn: 啧啧，太阳打西边出来了，你什么时候这么热心肠了？

say:44:1064301027:0.text: Hey, helping has always come naturally to me. Besides, it's boring just sitting around. Isn't that right, Boomboom?
say:44:1064301027:0.source_cn: 我一直都很热心好不好！而且多无聊，找点事做嘛。阿爆，对不对？

say:46:1064301028:0.text: Absolutely! Lady Kulu is always willing to lend a hand! She's nothing like those other Hypogeans!
say:46:1064301028:0.source_cn: 没错，库露露大人向来以助人为乐，和那些落后的老派恶魔可...

say:47:1064301029:0.text: Fine, go ahead. I'd better stay here and make sure things don't turn ugly between those two.
say:47:1064301029:0.source_cn: 行吧，你去就你去。正好我还得留在这里监场，免得那两个家...

say:48:1064301030:0.text: But if that strange guy turns out to be too much to handle, just give me a shout. I'll be right over.
say:48:1064301030:0.source_cn: 不过，要是对方真是个来闹事的硬茬子，别逞强，喊一声我就过来。

say:49:1064301031:0.text:
Trust me, I've got this.
Come on, Boomboom. Take me there!
say:49:1064301031:0.source_cn: 放心啦，交涉可是我的强项。\n走，阿爆，带路！

say:50:1064301032:0.text: Yes, Lady Kulu! This way, please!

say:54:1064301033:0.text:
Screw breech, composite magazine, all-metal barrel...
Everything checks out.
say:54:1064301033:0.source_cn: 螺式炮闩、聚合弹鼓、全金属膛管……\n军械，全备。

say:57:1064301034:0.text: As Kulu creeps up behind Gunnar...
say:57:1064301034:0.source_cn: 库露露轻手轻脚地接近勒图姆，突然……

say:59:1064301035:0.text: Suddenly, a bomb comes hurtling straight at her!
say:59:1064301035:0.source_cn: 一枚炮弹毫无预兆地向她袭来！

say:62:1064301036:0.text: In the nick of time, Boomboom balloons in size, opens its mouth wide, and swallows the bomb.
say:62:1064301036:0.source_cn: 库露露身边的阿爆急速膨胀，张开大嘴，一口将炮弹吞下。

say:64:1064301038:0.text:
Oh, my! Boomboom, are you okay?!
What's your problem, Metalhead? I didn't mess with you! Are you looking for a fight?!
say:64:1064301038:0.source_cn: 啊啊啊，阿爆你没事吧？！\n你你你，哪来的铁块头，我又...

say:65:1064301039:0.text: Ugh... Gugu... I-I need some time to digest this, Lady Kulu...
say:65:1064301039:0.source_cn: 呃……咕……主人，我、我得消化一下……

say:66:1064301040:0.text: Gunnar takes two steps forward for a closer look at Boomboom. The ground quivers slightly beneath his heavy footsteps.
say:66:1064301040:0.source_cn: 勒图姆向前走了两步，沉重的脚步让地面微微震动，他仔细打...

say:67:1064301041:0.text: Say something! Don't think you can get away with this by playing dumb, Metalhead!
say:67:1064301041:0.source_cn: 别以为装傻不说话就没事了，铁块头！

say:69:1064301043:1.text: Stop! I don't go by that name anymore! It's Lady Kulu now!
say:69:1064301043:1.source_cn: 住口！我早就不是过去那家伙了！现在的是新生的、伟大的库...

say:70:1064301044:1.text: Boomboom, are you done eating? Time to knock some sense into this arrogant fool!
say:70:1064301044:1.source_cn: 阿爆，调整好了就上，给这个目中无人的家伙一点颜色瞧瞧！

say:71:1064301045:1.text: *Burp* Lady Kulu, I-I... am ready for action.
say:71:1064301045:1.source_cn: 嗝——主人，我、我……随时准备出击。

say:72:1064301046:1.text:
My idol! Perfect!
Powerful bombs! Blow everything up!
say:72:1064301046:1.source_cn: 偶像，完美！\n强劲炸弹，荡平一切！

say:73:1064301047:1.text:
What? Hold it for a second, Boomboom...
Hey, Metalhead, did you just say something about your idol? Who's that?
say:73:1064301047:1.source_cn: 欸，等等，阿爆你先别动……\n铁块头，你刚刚说偶像、完...

say:75:1064301049:1.text: How dare you address Lady Kulu by her name!
say:75:1064301049:1.source_cn: 大胆，竟敢直呼库露露大人的名讳……

say:76:1064301050:1.text: Forget it, Boomboom. He doesn't seem to have much going on upstairs.
say:76:1064301050:1.source_cn: 算了算了，阿爆，这铁块头的脑子好像不太聪明。

say:77:1064301051:1.text: Since we both share a love of bombs, I'm going to let this slide. Just remember to call me Lady Kulu from now on!
say:77:1064301051:1.source_cn: 不过，看你也是个懂火力的家伙嘛，就不跟你计较了。以后得...

say:78:1064301052:1.text: Besides coming here to see me, why did you show up with someone else's invitation?
say:78:1064301052:1.source_cn: 说吧，除了见偶像以外，到这儿来干嘛，还拿着别人的邀请函...

say:79:1064301053:1.text:
Open contest.
Good chance. Test my weapons.
say:79:1064301053:1.source_cn: 竞赛，无限制。\n顶级火力，验证。

say:80:1064301054:1.text: What... You came all this way just to see if you can beat the dwarves and humans at making weapons? Hahaha! Well, I suppose that's a good enough reason.
say:80:1064301054:1.source_cn: 噗……你想跟那些矮人、人类比做武器？哈哈哈！勉强说得过去。

say:81:1064301055:1.text: Anyway, that shot you took at me earlier really, really got under my skin.
say:81:1064301055:1.source_cn: 不过，你刚才轰我那一炮，让我很不爽。非常、非常不爽。

say:82:1064301056:1.text: You've got to make it up to me somehow. You know, the way we do things back home.
say:82:1064301056:1.source_cn: 按照我们那儿的规矩，你得赔点好处，让我心情好受些，才能...

say:83:1064301057:1.text: Gunnar stares at Kulu dazedly, apparently failing to grasp what she means.
say:83:1064301057:1.source_cn: 勒图姆沉默地看着库露露，似乎不明白她所说的规矩是什么。

say:84:1064301058:1.text: Seriously, are you really one of us? You don't seem to know much besides fighting. Don't worry, I'm not taking your stuff for free. In return, I'll get your registration sorted out.
say:84:1064301058:1.source_cn: 你到底是不是我们那儿的，怎么除了打架什么都不懂。我可不...

say:85:1064301059:1.text: And I'm the only one who can help you. See that scary-looking dwarf lady over there? If she finds out there's a Hypogean among the contestants, you're done for. Trust me, she hits hard.
say:85:1064301059:1.source_cn: 不然，外面那个矮人老阿姨，要是她知道混进来一个恶魔——...

say:86:1064301060:1.text:
Your bomb. Can be optimized.
Explosive energy. Unstable.
say:86:1064301060:1.source_cn: 你的炸弹，吞能上限，可优化。\n爆炸能量，易失衡。

say:87:1064301061:1.text:
More powerful. After modification.
I prepare materials.
say:87:1064301061:1.source_cn: 改装，火力升级。\n材料，我自备。

say:88:1064301062:1.source_cn: 啧啧，免费给我升级炸弹？

say:89:1064301063:1.text: Sounds good. Just remember, I want my bomb to be both practical and stylish. Use the finest materials you can find!
say:89:1064301063:1.source_cn: 听起来不赖，不过得改时髦点，时髦，你懂吗？得用最好的材...

say:90:1064301064:1.text: By the way, what's your name? If you don't honor your deal, I'll hunt you down in the abyss!
say:90:1064301064:1.source_cn: 还有，你叫什么来着？要是你赖账，我好去深渊下面找你！

say:92:1064301066:0.text: That's a pretty cool name... Now stay here, keep a low profile, and try not to blow up everything in sight.
say:92:1064301066:0.source_cn: 名字挺有派头的嘛……你就在这待着吧，低调点，别动不动就开炮！

say:96:1064301067:1.text: Back already?! So, what's the deal with that guy? I hope he didn't give you too much trouble.
say:96:1064301067:1.source_cn: 这么快就回来啦。怎么样，是哪里来的家伙，没有碰到棘手的...

say:97:1064301068:1.text: Who am I? The great Lady Kulu! There's no problem I can't solve!
say:97:1064301068:1.source_cn: 那还用说，无敌的本大人出马，问题当然圆满解决咯！

say:98:1064301069:1.text: Turns out he was disfigured in a workshop accident, and he's been a little eccentric ever since. As for the invitation, he got it from a friend who couldn't make it today.
say:98:1064301069:1.source_cn: 是个工坊出过事故的工匠，脸毁容了，性格就有点古怪。邀请...

say:99:1064301070:1.text: This is a weapon-making contest, not a beauty pageant. Who cares what he looks like?
say:99:1064301070:1.source_cn: 反正是比拼武器制造嘛，又不是选美，长成什么样有什么关系。

say:100:1064301071:1.text: That's it? It's not like you to defend a stranger for no reason.
say:100:1064301071:1.source_cn: 就这么简单？帮陌生人说好话，可不常见呢。

say:101:1064301072:1.text: Okay, okay, I know I can't hide anything from you. Truth is, he offered to help me upgrade my bomb.
say:101:1064301072:1.source_cn: 哎呀，就知道瞒不了你。他给了我点好处，帮我改造了个小玩意儿。

say:102:1064301073:1.text: So I agreed to help him sort things out in return. What can I say? I'm a Hypogean with a heart, you know.
say:102:1064301073:1.source_cn: 作为具有感恩之心的恶魔，我就只好帮帮他咯。

say:103:1064301074:1.text:
Honestly, I don't know what to do when you're this forthright.
But if he causes any trouble in Brimstone Village...
say:103:1064301074:1.source_cn: 怎么能这么直白地就说出来，真是拿你没办法。\n丑话说在...

say:104:1064301075:1.text: Relax, he's too chicken to try anything funny. Alright, I've got places to be. Catch you later!
say:104:1064301075:1.source_cn: 放心吧，他胆子小得很，不敢乱来的！就这样，我还有事呢，...
